notes.title: Super Seducer April 26, 2018 Update

-CHINESE LANGUAGE ADDED!!!!  
我们很高兴的宣布本游戏从现在起可以选择中文。

-By current estimates, there have been 1500 couples formed and 240 new pregnancies as a direct result of Richard's teachings in Super Seducer.  Lots of people are calling babies born between 2018-2020 part of the "Super Seducer Generation".
